values.note: Check-in and check-out 2 pm Monday-Saturday, 5 pm Sundays and holidays.

note: Buffalo Ridge campground: Ogle Lake is nearby but the campground sits on a ridge above it, not lakefront. RVs must use the west gate on SR 46: the north entrance has a covered bridge with a 9-ft clearance and 3-ton limit, and GPS may route you to the wrong gate. --Claude
summary: Fees, 50A, year-round confirmed (rates within DNR's published standard ranges); count none -> 429, camp store, dump and ReserveAmerica link added; note corrected on the gate limit.
flags: PHONE: stored empty; park office is 812-988-6406 (https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/parks-lakes/brown-county-state-park/).

SPLIT: not recommended. Campground loops share one park road off the west gate; the pinned ridge loop and the next loop south are about 650 m apart on imagery (not labelled individually), with no entrances of their own. The Horsemen's camp has its own entrance at 4800 S.R. 135 S; horse sites do not qualify, so no entry needed.
ACCESS: north gate's 9-ft clearance and 3-ton limit exclude EKKO (under 10.5 ft, ~9,500 lb); west gate has no stated limit, so criteria pass with the caveat kept in the note.
HOOKUPS: Raccoon Ridge electric is 20A per ReserveAmerica; stored 50 kept because the stored value came from the old note on Buffalo Ridge and no page denies it. Not re-verified per site.
PIN: good, on the ridge-top camp loops (Buffalo/Raccoon Ridge).
